rationale: Several papers, including 2106.15745, 1907.08534, 1908.10352, 2310.11588, and 1902.05078, contribute substantive new evidence on constraining the neutron star equation of state using gravitational wave observations. These studies use various methods and data, such as gravitational wave observations from neutron star mergers, to provide constraints on the equation of state, but the question is not fully settled.
